'''catman421 X-wings (MISC) (V1)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[catman421]]
* '''Published:''' 28 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed TRM catman421 LS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck uses Incom Corperation on Yavin while X-wings battle and force drain.

== Strategy ==

This deck requires Incom to be out early to boost X-wings.  The characters are used for Never Tell Me the Odds.  Houjix and Hyper Escapes are for stopping battles or extreme losses.  Organized Assaults are to boost the power of the Xwings.  This deck needs some more systems in it though.
